name: titan-ahrefs
description: Standalone Ahrefs API v3 SEO analytics engine, backlink monitor, SERP rank tracker, and historical snapshot logger for independent target domains.
responsibilities: Ahrefs API v3 integration & rate-limited client management
Domain Rating (DR) & URL Rating (UR) metric tracking
Backlink profile monitoring (new vs. lost backlinks, anchor text distribution)
SERP keyword ranking audits & position delta tracking
Historical metrics snapshot logging & trend analysis
Weekly automated executive markdown & JSON report generation

required.name: AHREFS_API_KEY
required.description: Ahrefs API v3 Bearer authentication token

optional.name: AHREFS_API_BASE_URL
optional.description: Ahrefs API endpoint base URL (default: https://api.ahrefs.com/v3)
